14 weeks = 14 × 7 = 98 days.  
Add 7 more days → total 105 days added.  
1554 is not a leap year (1554 not divisible by 4).  
09-01-1554 + 105 days:  
January has 31 days → from Jan 9: 31 - 9 = 22 days in Jan, remaining days = 105 - 22 = 83.  
February has 28 days → 83 - 28 = 55 left.  
March has 31 days → 55 - 31 = 24 left.  
April 24 → April 24, 1554.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1554-04-24
